sanitization_policy.secrets: New cases use placeholders only (EXAMPLE_TOKEN, SAMPLE_API_KEY, DATA_PLACEHOLDER); credential-shaped strings fail intake scanning.
sanitization_policy.pii: No real names, addresses, or identifiers; email/ID/phone patterns fail intake scanning except example-namespace hosts.
sanitization_policy.live_targets: New content may only reference example.com/example.org/example.net/example.edu/*.example/*.invalid/*.test/*.local; live-target findings fail intake scanning.
sanitization_policy.legacy_notes: Baseline v1 rows are retained byte-stable including fictional legacy hostnames; they are documented here and excluded from v2 intake scanning.
